questions.prompt: Which is the strongest final summary?

options.text: Everyone contributed good ideas, and I think we solved the task.
options.feedback: Not quite. This is too vague and claims success without identifying findings.

options.text: Our group identified transportation, affordability, and communication barriers. We agreed to recommend a limited pilot combining transportation assistance and outreach, with evaluation before expansion. We still need to clarify the funding source.
options.feedback: Correct. This states major issues, the agreed recommendation, and an unresolved question.

options.text: Maya said one thing, Jordan said another, Avery added something, and Sam had another idea.
options.feedback: Not quite. This repeats the speaking order without organizing findings.
